summary: Correction round 2 for task 10.1 (implementation unchanged; production behavior unchanged). Correction 1 (TQ-10.1-01, MEDIUM) replaced the vacuous renderer-output-fingerprint test with ChangingVerbosityDoesNotChangeTheProductionRegenerationDecision, which drives the real production path: two PluginConfigurationSnapshot values that differ only in LogVerbosity feed ArtworkRegenerationPlanner.ComputeDesiredFingerprint and ArtworkRegenerationPlanner.Decide with their own snapshot-derived BadgeDefinitions, RendererOutputPolicy, and RendererConfigurationFingerprint. The warning snapshot's desired fingerprint is stored as the published state's PublishedFingerprint, and the test asserts the desired fingerprints for the warning and trace snapshots are equal and that both Decide calls return Skip with a null DesiredFingerprint. The test is non-vacuous: I temporarily threaded LogVerbosity into PluginConfigurationSnapshot.From's rendererConfigurationFingerprint and the strengthened test (and the configuration-fingerprint test) failed, then reverted the temporary mutation and reconfirmed green. This also closes TQ-10.1-02 by dropping the tautological RenderVersion assertions on test-built inputs (no fake version added) and TQ-10.1-04 by asserting the production planner's fingerprint-gated Skip for a verbosity-only change, so 'changing verbosity never republishes artwork' is now proven on the production path rather than transitively. The local BuildFingerprintInput helper and the unused ItemId field/imports were removed; test-local PublishedState/SourceA fixtures were added following ArtworkRegenerationPlannerTests conventions. Correction 2 (implementation-reviewer finding 10.1-F1) updated the docs/architecture.md line-3 status line: it now records Phase 9 as complete (Gate 9 met; tag v1.1.0-phase9) and Phase 10 task 10.1 as adding the bounded LogVerbosity setting and the plugin-owned logging/verbosity gate with tasks 10.2-10.3 remaining, replacing the stale 'pending its independent phase review and tag' wording. No other part of that line or document was rewritten; SEC-5 was not touched and no production log call site was added.
